runtime_adaptation: Twelve specialty perspectives grouped across three workers under the four-slot runtime; not twelve independent reviewers.

findings.root_cause: Permissionless one-atomic-unit deposits could consume all globally bounded LP account slots indefinitely.
findings.proof: With one seeded lot, 63 dust contributions cost 63 USDC atomic units and consume the other slots. Exit-requesting them excludes their underwriting risk, while nonzero equity prevents permissionless archival.
findings.fix: Per-deposit capacity authorization binds owner, exact amount, unique consumed ID, deadline, chain, vault and current signer version under both settlement and risk signatures.
findings.remaining_scope: Authorized admission policy and adequate public scaling remain unapproved; signatures do not establish wallet identity.

findings.root_cause: A legitimate final void determined after cutoff could neither resolve in the old day nor permit closing the expired open bet.
findings.proof: Acceptance T-60 seconds, expiry T-30, final void determination T+10: old resolve rejects next-day canonical time while old close rejects unresolved expiry before T.
findings.fix: Authenticate the future-day final void without releasing accepted risk or customer stake; preceding closes retain that exposure and may advance; exact-once completion requires the canonical day and pays the original owner.

addressed_leads.scope: Synthetic MAX_MONEY domain, larger than realistic USDC funding
addressed_leads.cause: Acceptance could fit current money bounds while a later winning credit or losing stake exceeded the accounting domain.
addressed_leads.fix: Reserve all open losing-stake headroom in LP capital and all open winning-bonus headroom in custody before acceptance/deposit.

batch_followup: Three workers found no new concrete issue in netting, original owners, duplicate/invalid rollback or millisecond seams. Future-day voids must use queue/completion rather than blind batch submission. Default compilation stack depth was fixed by extracting the loop, without changing compiler settings.
remaining_requirements: Target-chain transaction gas and maximum-open-bet close verification
Durable shared-engine/onchain stage bindings and relay/recovery
Funded reward reservations and LP incentive checkpoints
Economic sign-off, actual funding and deployment rehearsal
